commits.message:
docs(style): document the degrade-versus-strict contract (rich-diagnostics-un7.5) (#141)

* docs(style): document the degrade-versus-strict contract (rich-diagnostics-un7.5)

docs/style.md never said that an invalid style inside text is dropped
silently, so a reader whose text printed plain had nothing to go on. The
new "When a style is invalid" section says what degrades (styles attached
to text: markup tags, RichText styles, spans, highlighters) and what throws
StyleSyntaxError (Style.parse, new Theme, print/Console style options, a
renderable's own border/rule/guide styles), links markup parse errors to
docs/markup.md, and covers onStyleError, including the did-you-mean message
and per-resolution call counts, and rethrowing from it as the strict mode.

docs/markup.md's parse-errors section now points a misspelled style name
at that section, since it is not a parse error.

Every behavioral claim and the sample message were checked against real
output. renderToString has no handler; that gap is filed as
rich-diagnostics-ejn.

* docs(style): drop the panel title from the styles that degrade

A Panel reads its title as plain text, so a style on it is never resolved
and never reaches onStyleError. The sentence now names only a table cell,
which does degrade and report. The title bug is rich-panel ticket filed
separately.
